title: Impact Analysis – GF-34567: Active-Account Contacts to Opportunity Contact Roles LWC
brief_description: Build a Lightning Web Component that lists Contacts of Active Accounts and lets a user assign selected Contacts as Opportunity Contact Roles from the Opportunity record page.
executive_summary: Introduces a new LWC on the Opportunity record page that displays a paginated (5/page), multi-select table of Contacts belonging to Active Accounts (Name as hyperlink, Email, Account Name, Department). Selected Contacts advance to a second table where the user assigns a standard Role; on Save the system creates OpportunityContactRole records for the current Opportunity and shows a success toast. Requires a new Account.Active__c checkbox, a supporting Apex controller (query + DML), and its test class.
scope: There will be no downstream impact on any system with these changes.

components.name: Account.Active__c
components.description: New Checkbox field on Account defining an 'Active' Account. Contacts are filtered on Account.Active__c = true. Net-new at objects/Account/fields/Active__c.field-meta.xml.

components.name: OpportunityContactRoleController
components.description: Server controller. getActiveAccountContacts() returns Contacts (Name, Email, Account.Name, Department) whose Account.Active__c = true; createContactRoles(opportunityId, contactIds, role) inserts OpportunityContactRole records for the current Opportunity.

components.name: OpportunityContactRoleControllerTest
components.description: Apex test class providing coverage for the controller query and DML paths (deploy requirement).

components.name: contactOpportunityRoleManager
components.description: Two-step UI exposed to lightning__RecordPage (Opportunity). Step 1: paginated (5/page), multi-select datatable of Active-Account Contacts with Contact Name as a hyperlink. Step 2 (after Next): table of selected Contacts with a standard OpportunityContactRole Role picker. On Save, creates OpportunityContactRole records using @api recordId as the OpportunityId and shows a success toast.
